name: @emsenn/claude-code-topology
description: Claude Code as a meme-topology carrier: the application embodies an agent (agent-topology) and runs it on a claude model (claude-topology). The composition agent + claude-models — the 'claude-code' half of the claude-code-cli-harness diamond; it carries no harness slots of its own.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test
